# obot_mcp_access_rules (Data Source)

Lists zero or more policies under MCP Servers > Access Policies, sorted by ID. Use to discover Everything and its actual subjects before import. This lookup makes no changes and does not read vMCP profiles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "obot_mcp_access_rules" "current" {
  catalog_id = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `catalog_id` (String) The catalog to inspect; defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) Current catalog access policies, including generated rules, sorted by ID. An empty catalog returns an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `catalog_id` (String) The catalog containing this policy.
- `display_name` (String) The policy's display name; names need not be unique.
- `generated` (Boolean) Whether Obot generated this rule. Generated rules cannot be managed by the Terraform resource.
- `id` (String) The access-control rule identifier.
- `resources` (Attributes Set) Actual resources covered by this policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--resources))
- `subjects` (Attributes Set) Actual subjects receiving this grant. Inspect these before importing; Everything is a name, not an everyone selector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--subjects))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.resources`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The referenced ID or wildcard `*`.
- `type` (String) The reference type.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--subjects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.subjects`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The referenced ID or wildcard `*`.
- `type` (String) The reference type.
